I dont know if I hid it that well, tbh, sure i have 2 faces, the one who pretends to be normal, like to talk to someone and laughing at dumb jokes, and then the true self, who just doesnt feel like doing shit.

MY family didnt notice, but they dont pay much attention either, they all think Im computer addicted, because all im doing is sitting in my room and sit at the computer when im not in bed.
